title: Materialize one provider-neutral Shared Ray/Path Tracing Fabric
decision: Create one CFA3-native shared, non-authoritative ray/path tracing resolver and typed contract surface bound to existing CAP-127, Engine Selection, HRB, Render Fabric and Neural Rendering boundaries. Preserve explicit CPU software and NVIDIA/AMD/Intel accelerator paths. Do not admit a runtime provider, model, driver or Current Host PASS in this change.
owner_approval_basis: User approved the next task: Shared Ray/Path Tracing Fabric materialization.
